gameplan.summary: Win lane through bleed stacks and all-ins. Snowball kills into Noxian Might for free kills.
gameplan.win_condition: Stack bleed to 5 and execute with Noxus Guillotine. Dominate side lane.
gameplan.early_game: Level 1 E to pull then Q heal. Level 3 is first kill window. Max Q.
gameplan.positioning: Flank at choke points. Use E to pull isolated targets. Never fight without Tenacity vs CC.

garen.tips: He silences you — don't use E while silenced. Bait his W then commit. Win long trades.
garen.power_shift: You win extended trades with bleed. Short trades favor Garen. Force long fights.

fiora.tips: She parries your E pull — never use E as opener. Bait parry with auto, then Q+E combo.
fiora.power_shift: She outduels you at 2+ items. Win via roaming and taking objectives.

quinn.tips: Her E knock-back cancels your pull. Rush Merc Treads. Freeze lane and roam.
quinn.power_shift: She kites you all game. Win through splitpush when she's elsewhere.

malphite.tips: You shred his armor with passive. Free all-in at level 3. Ignite + full combo wins early.
malphite.power_shift: You win all stages of the game 1v1. Avoid his teamfight ult setup.

rumble.tips: Respect his Q poke at range. All-in when he's overheated. Use E pull to gap-close through his E slow.
rumble.power_shift: You win level 1-5. He outscales in teamfights. Win before he gets 2 items.
